pkgmetadata.longdescription: The free and open-source audiolaz player takes music from Roon (as a Squeezebox player), Lyrion/LMS, its own UPnP/DLNA renderer, AirPlay (shairport-sync) and Spotify Connect (librespot), and plays it to an ALSA card, Squeezebox players, UPnP renderers or audiolaz Link receivers, without resampling or processing. While it plays it compares every frame in and out and says on its web page and GET /state whether the stream is bit-perfect. Also installs audiolaz-recv (the audiolaz Link receiver) and the "audiolaz" ALSA output plug-in.

use.flag: Pull in media-libs/flac, which the player opens at run time to play FLAC streams from Roon/LMS and UPnP (its headers are needed to build either way)
